sql.propToolProductUtilityState.getAllForCom: select p.id, p.product_id, p.utility_state_id, p.funding_cap, p.target_production_factor, p.archived from props.product_utility_state p where p.archived is not true
sql.propToolProductUtilityState.insert: insert into props.product_utility_state(product_id, utility_state_id, funding_cap, target_production_factor) values (:productId, :utilityStateId, :fundingCap, :targetProductionFactor)
sql.propToolProductUtilityState.update: update props.product_utility_state set product_id = :productId, utility_state_id = :utilityStateId, funding_cap = :fundingCap, target_production_factor = :targetProductionFactor where id = :id
sql.propToolProductUtilityState.delete: update props.product_utility_state set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
